services.name: Boat Rentals - 23' Sea Pro, "REEL FISH"
services.desc: 1 to 7 days About Rent our fishing and sightseeing boat for you and your group! Be your own captain self-guided! Rent the Reel Fish, a 23-foot Sea Pro open center console fiberglass boat with a nice bimbini overhead and control station. The captain driving seat can have 2 people there and the cooler seat infront can seat 2 and the bow floor can seat an additional person. The Garmin chart plotter and fish finder help with navigation! The center console has a porta potty marine head inside. All USCG safety items are on board. Go on your own adventure at your own Daily or Weekly Rentals • Up to 5 People

With a fold down bench sleeping platform to a medium sized back deck, this boat is great for many activities from day trips for fishing and or exploring etc to overnight Daily or Weekly Rentals • Up to 6 People

The Scavenger has dinette seating for 4 on the port side and bench seating for 2 on starboard. includes: Alaska fishing licenses and gratuities are not included in the quoted rate.
You will need the 1 day sport fishing license, and all trips with salmon fishing included will also need the king salmon stamp.
Water and light snacks are provided.
Bait, tackle, and gear are provided.
